subject: Kickoff: HarborEdge turnkey on-prem deployment & VPC peering
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex@harboredge.io>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: HarborEdge turnkey on-prem deployment & VPC peering

Dylan / Monica / Jordan,

Thanks again for the intro call earlier — HarborEdge is excited to get the private deployment moving. We want a turnkey on-prem + VPC peering setup so our ML inference can run within our datacenter and also accept requests from our cloud services via a private peering link. Highlights / asks from our side: 

- We have an initial network diagram attached (harboredge-network-draft.pdf).
- Primary questions: required public IP ranges, TLS cert expectations, and whether Redwood will generate edge certs or we must bring our own.
- We run certificate rotation via a central vault; need to confirm HSM/KMS integration points.
- Desired timeline: pilot in staging by Oct 1, production cutover mid-Oct.

Can you propose a short implementation playbook and a list of items HarborEdge needs to prepare? Also looping in our infra lead Michael (cc).

Best,
Alex Rivera
Head of Platform
HarborEdge Systems

Attachment: harboredge-network-draft.pdf (diagram, 1 page)
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@harboredge.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Santos <michael.santos@harboredge.io>
Date: 2026-09-03T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: HarborEdge turnkey on-prem deployment & VPC peering

Alex — thanks for the clear asks and the diagram, this is great. Attached is a first-draft implementation playbook (redwood-onprem-playbook-v1.docx) that outlines the minimal network and ops checklist for a turnkey install. High-level plan below: 

1) Discovery (this week) — confirm IP ranges, NAT requirements, and firewall egress rules. HarborEdge action: export current subnet list and peering VLANs.
2) Staging rollout (2 weeks) — deploy a single-node on-prem package behind your private endpoint; validate model download, inference, and telemetry. Redwood action: provide a staging artifact and a temporary access key.
3) VPC peering & routing (1 week) — set up peering with your cloud VPC; test sample traffic and enforce SNI/mTLS. HarborEdge action: provide BGP or route table admin access.
4) Production cutover & HSM integration — work with your security team on cert rotation and KMS hooks.

A few clarifying points we need answered to finalize the runbook:
- Do you plan to terminate TLS at your edge gateway or at Redwood's private endpoint appliance?
- Which KMS/HSM vendor do you use (AWS KMS, HashiCorp, Thales, YubiHSM)?
- Any regulatory requirements (data residency, audit retention) that change the deployment?

If helpful I can host a 30-min technical kickoff with Monica (CS lead) and Jordan (network eng) to walk the playbook and assign owners. Proposed times: Thu 09/03 4:00pm PT or Fri 09/04 9:00am PT.

Talk soon,

Dylan Brooks
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-onprem-playbook-v1.docx (implementation playbook, v1)
From: Michael Santos <michael.santos@harboredge.io>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Rivera <alex@harboredge.io>
Date: 2026-09-03T13:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: HarborEdge turnkey on-prem deployment & VPC peering

Dylan / Monica — quick clarifications from our infra team after reviewing your playbook: 

- We will terminate TLS at our edge LB. We expect Redwood to honor client certs and support mTLS to the private endpoint.
- HSM: we run HashiCorp Vault backed by an internal HSM cluster. We can provide a cert rotation API and service account.
- IPs: attaching a short list of public/private subnets and the questions we have about NAT sticky sessions.

See attached: harboredge-cert-rotation-questions.txt.

We can do Fri 09/04 9:00am PT for the technical kickoff.

—Michael
Michael Santos
Director, Infrastructure
HarborEdge Systems

Attachment: harboredge-cert-rotation-questions.txt (3 bullet questions on rotation and HSM integration)
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-04T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Kickoff: HarborEdge turnkey on-prem deployment & VPC peering

Team — forwarding the thread after Michael's notes. Quick internal asks before the Fri kickoff: 

- Markus: can you confirm whether our on-prem appliance supports mTLS with a Vault-backed HSM for cert rotation? If not, what is the estimated work (config changes or small code path) to support HashiCorp Vault hooks?
- Jordan: please prepare a short checklist for BGP vs static route options and expected firewall rules we will ask HarborEdge to open.
- Monica: I'll run the kickoff and own the staging rollout; please prep a one-page SLO checklist (latency targets, telemetry endpoints, rollback criteria).

I've uploaded the current playbook draft and the HarborEdge attachments to the Confluence page: https://redwoodinference.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PS/pages/PS-789-turnkey-onprem-playbook — think of this as the living runbook for the engagement.

If you want, we can pre-align on the responses to Michael's three HSM questions before the call — I'd like to answer them in one go.

Thanks,
Dylan
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
